senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="Q00537">preced.</cite> wds.). m. (<cite ref="Q00537">preced.</cite> wds.).

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:5:4">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הפ׳ שבירושלם</he> the druggists of Jerusalem.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:3:5">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᶜ</cite> top <he>כדרך שהפ׳ עושין</he> as the apothecaries are in the habit of doing.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:2">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 21:4">Yalk. ib. 21</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00120"><he>בְּדוֹלַח</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: one who fattens animals for sale, dealer in fattened animals, opp. to רועה.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 29b:7">Bets. 29ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:6">Tosef. ib. III, 6</cite> <he>הולך … אצל הפ׳ וכ׳</he> a person may go (on the Holy Day) to a dealer whose regular customer he is, and say, give me a dove &c.

Bets. 38ᵃ שור של פ׳ an ox at the dealer’s stall, contrad. to של רועה. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 104ᵇ אצל הפ׳ … פטומות he took her to the crammer, and filled her lap with crammed birds; Yalk. Ex. 273; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:9">Erub. X, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 101a:12">101ᵃ</cite>) <he>שוק של פ׳</he> the crammers’ market.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 5:8">Tosef. Shebi. V, 8</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:4">Sabb. XX, 4</cite>; Y. ib. 17ᶜ bot., v. <cite ref="T00893"><he>רְעִי</he> I</cite>.
